notes.manas-2010:p0334:b001:l004: Literal paternal-grave imprecation; repeated occurrences retained as curses rather than statements about a grave.
notes.manas-2010:p0334:b001:l007: Formulaic wish that the adversary burn, not a report that he has burned. Similar curses recur throughout this speech.
notes.manas-2010:p0334:b001:l008: Кызыталак is rendered as an abusive intensifier, damned; its literal sexual/divorce etymology is not repeated in English.
notes.manas-2010:p0334:b001:l017: Bakburchun is retained as named. The promise of its khanship is expressed as its throne; printed канын has compressed syntax.
notes.manas-2010:p0334:b001:l022: Жолум үй is a temporary travel shelter; comparison conveys Zholoy’s bulk.
notes.manas-2010:p0334:b001:l035: Döngö and Kaman are named among missing champions; later direct address to Döngö is not harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p0334:b001:l039: Gift/booty image preserved: the army has let the Burut take its champions.
notes.manas-2010:p0334:b001:l042: Batman is a historical variable measure; no unsupported modern conversion. Seven/six batmans and seventy/sixty giants are retained separately.
notes.manas-2010:p0335:b001:l007: Command literally tells the warrior to die and come; idiomatic go and die retains the impossible return as death-bound command.
notes.manas-2010:p0335:b001:l018: Yudakhin мыйзам II explicitly gives airborne autumn gossamer and quotes the matching paired formula with гүлү. Current PDF prints күлү; gossamer reading supported by dictionary parallel, while raw variant remains unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0335:b001:l023: Эпсиз is read contextually as formidable/beyond measure, not clumsy.
notes.manas-2010:p0335:b001:l039: Curse and eye image retained rather than reduced to a generic insult.
notes.manas-2010:p0335:b001:l043: Bring him alive contradicts the preceding killing commands; both are retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0335:b001:l045: Казына here provisionally denotes the royal establishment/treasury household. The next rows explicitly threaten coerced breeding and subsequent killing; content not softened.
notes.manas-2010:p0335:b001:l046: Literal stallion metaphor expresses threatened reproductive coercion, not consensual courtship.
notes.manas-2010:p0336:b001:l008: Printed журутка and clause ending are awkward; construed as the people under the commanders’ control whom they must not surrender. Raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0336:b001:l019: Даңгыт: large fierce dog in epic usage; not silently read as a people’s name here. Threat of being torn open for dogs retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0336:b001:l027: Eyes blinded can describe humiliation/distress; deliberately close to source image.
notes.manas-2010:p0336:b001:l029: Сын is discerning or judging the child’s nature/portents, not modern criticism.
notes.manas-2010:p0336:b001:l033: Jakyp’s fat is the feast/bribe image; literal food retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0336:b001:l043: Age limits retained literally: older than six months, younger than sixteen; year supplied by age context only in interpretation.
notes.manas-2010:p0337:b001:l004: Seemingly upright is an ironic contextual reading of түз; no textual emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p0337:b001:l018: Жандап is read as passing beside/near without investigating.
notes.manas-2010:p0337:b001:l024: Calf is a contemptuous metaphor for the false Manas.
notes.manas-2010:p0337:b001:l030: Straw-stuffed sack comparison retained across two rows.
notes.manas-2010:p0337:b001:l034: Бээлебей provisionally understood as failing to take control/heeding no check; local syntax is uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0337:b001:l040: Source says Manas arose from Beejin although nearby rows name Altay as birthplace. No geographical correction imposed.
notes.manas-2010:p0337:b001:l045: Shorn beard is humiliation metaphor, not an independently established event.
notes.manas-2010:p0337:b001:l047: Кылым is interpreted as peoples/world here, not a number of centuries.
notes.manas-2010:p0338:b001:l008: Суук боор literally cold-hearted; nominal referent uncertain. No additional ethnic or human identity supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0338:b001:l012: Даңза: written register, here containing prophecy. Not assumed a surviving historical document.
notes.manas-2010:p0338:b001:l013: White deer made cattle is a domination/taming image; species retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0338:b001:l021: Менде read as mortal (пенде variant), not first-person locative. Crushing adversaries into bread continues devouring metaphor.
notes.manas-2010:p0338:b001:l024: Жүн кылат literally makes wool, a pulverizing/trampling image.
notes.manas-2010:p0338:b001:l044: Taste your salt retains the punitive idiom after beating, not hospitality; English remains deliberately literal.
notes.manas-2010:p0338:b001:l046: Thimble mouth and young-camel eyes are beauty comparisons; camel-eyed retains source animal image.
notes.manas-2010:p0339:b001:l003: Капка means city gate in Yudakhin, supporting gate’s mouth in the Beejin destruction context. The inflected spelling Капканын is retained; a trap-associated reading remains grammatically possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0339:b001:l008: Бут is idol in this religious-destruction context, not foot; possessive form бутуңду.
notes.manas-2010:p0339:b001:l016: Кычкыл кыял аш provisionally interpreted as sour intoxicating brew in parallel with drinking away the mind.
notes.manas-2010:p0339:b001:l026: Repeated Kakan-Kakanchyn form retained, not normalized away.
notes.manas-2010:p0339:b001:l032: Died is hyperbolic fright; speaker continues narrating.
notes.manas-2010:p0339:b001:l046: Алты сай is retained as six-grooved/channeled hail, an unusual descriptive formula, not six separate storms.
notes.manas-2010:p0340:b001:l002: Eighty-day rain retained despite subsequent next-day transition; no chronology repaired.
notes.manas-2010:p0340:b001:l015: Супа садык: true dawn, from the conventional dawn expression.
notes.manas-2010:p0340:b001:l019: Бор is cannon/artillery in martial context. Калдай translated governor, per project glossary; historical rank not equated with a modern office precisely.
notes.manas-2010:p0340:b001:l024: Sixty leaves retained, not converted into 120 printed pages.
notes.manas-2010:p0340:b001:l030: Circumcision sign rendered literally; religious birth portent, not a medical assertion.
notes.manas-2010:p0340:b001:l031: Birth in Beejin is explicitly printed; preserved despite Altay elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p0340:b001:l034: Six lions retained as figurative genealogical/heroic grouping; identities not supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0340:b001:l044: Seven forefathers/generations is the source’s ancestral formula; its slaughter claim not historically verified.
notes.manas-2010:p0341:b001:l009: Ram and wether both retained from кочкор ирик despite biological tension. Birth description is figurative.
notes.manas-2010:p0341:b001:l013: Flame standing apart is a close provisional rendering of бөлүнүп турган; following witnesses and deaths kept as narrated.
notes.manas-2010:p0341:b001:l025: Бушман is dismay/distress/grief in Yudakhin and the 1969/2015 dictionaries; not душман (enemy).
notes.manas-2010:p0341:b001:l027: Prophetic bodily signs retained as epic narration.
notes.manas-2010:p0341:b001:l040: Source says from twelve thousand barren mares; not asserted that all twelve thousand were slaughtered.
notes.manas-2010:p0342:b001:l004: Жинди is the concealing name Madman; translated to preserve its meaning. Чоң Жинди is Great Madman.
notes.manas-2010:p0342:b001:l011: Кыркы is the child’s fortieth-day observance; distinguished from the birth feast.
notes.manas-2010:p0342:b001:l012: Eight thousand mares retained without reconciling the preceding twelve-thousand figure.
notes.manas-2010:p0342:b001:l017: Кемеге: cooking hearth/trench, not a boat. Feast context supports broad dug cooking trenches.
notes.manas-2010:p0342:b001:l022: Concealed object understood as the child’s identity/affair; not invented as a new incident.
notes.manas-2010:p0342:b001:l033: Калдай translated governor, consistent with project glossary.
notes.manas-2010:p0342:b001:l044: Ninety camel-loads of gold retained as printed, without harmonizing earlier tribute totals.
notes.manas-2010:p0343:b001:l012: Text explicitly replaces Chege’s name with Kutubiy; name change preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0343:b001:l018: Кутусу read as Kutu, shortened name associated with Kutubiy; uncertain naming morphology noted rather than normalized.
notes.manas-2010:p0343:b001:l019: Кутман conveys auspiciousness/good fortune and echoes Kutubiy/Kutu; English gives semantic value, losing the sound-play.
notes.manas-2010:p0343:b001:l027: Source explicitly identifies the companion as a Kalmyk boy; retained without harmonizing affiliations elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p0343:b001:l039: Mecca is retained as epic recruitment geography; no historical plausibility claim.
notes.manas-2010:p0343:b001:l045: Жергеси өчтүү: provisionally his land/people bear a grudge; exact possessive relation uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0344:b001:l002: Көйкашка read as bold/distinguished champion, not confidently identified as a proper name. Future companion remains unnamed here.
notes.manas-2010:p0344:b001:l008: Көрөсөн: Yudakhin gives stately/splendid; translated splendid rather than an unsupported Khorasan origin. Spear action is a provisional reading of айза кыйбайбы.
notes.manas-2010:p0344:b001:l025: Tulpar retained as individual epic horse term; here a heroic steed, not an invented horse name.
notes.manas-2010:p0344:b001:l028: Ык болот provisionally advantage/suitability from tending the steed; compressed phrasing remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0344:b001:l030: Become forty retained literally, apparently anticipating forty companions; no additional clause inserted into the verse.
notes.manas-2010:p0344:b001:l034: Closing speech quotation supplied editorially at transition to narrator; raw punctuation unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0345:b001:l006: Tyrgoot retained as epic ethnonym; no precise modern identity imposed.
notes.manas-2010:p0345:b001:l011: Kün Zhang-Zhung named here, Ay Zhang-Zhung later on the same page; variants retained rather than silently merged.
notes.manas-2010:p0345:b003:l007: Күбө denotes armor in this context; blue/green color term көк rendered blue.
notes.manas-2010:p0345:b003:l009: Себил can mean protective battle clothing/arms; linked mail selected from чынжыр context.
notes.manas-2010:p0345:b003:l014: Көөр is precious stone/gem in Yudakhin and 1969 dictionary; jewel button as big as a fist. No particular gem species asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0345:b003:l017: Without a mane retained although next row describes tying mane and tail; no consistency emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p0345:b003:l027: Карыш is a handspan; no modern measurement imposed.
notes.manas-2010:p0346:b001:l002: Кечил has monk and epic Kalmyk senses. Yudakhin’s cotton-sash/broad-boot formula supports Kalmyks here; not translated as a new group called Kechil.
notes.manas-2010:p0346:b001:l007: Same epic Kalmyk sense of кечил as line2; dictionary-supported, not a claim about all religious usages.
notes.manas-2010:p0346:b001:l018: Кымбат is contextually difficult/perilous terrain rather than monetary value; provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0346:b001:l020: Чыдоосуна жүрүшкөн is compressed: understood as reliance on the mount’s endurance.
notes.manas-2010:p0346:b001:l028: Literally no wisdom remained away from Esen; interpreted as missing none of it in view of the following praise. Alternative loss-of-wisdom reading conflicts with that context; uncertain syntax noted.
notes.manas-2010:p0346:b001:l032: Eyes open may imply perception/clairvoyance; literal image kept with next row’s seer/judge description.
notes.manas-2010:p0346:b001:l039: Garden and court phrases shift construction; no new travel event supplied beyond source prepositional sequence.
notes.manas-2010:p0346:b001:l046: Тоту куш translated parrot; ornamental tail plume may have a broader epic bird referent. Species identification provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0347:b001:l006: Темир аркан тон taken as rope and armor rather than an iron-rope coat; punctuation absent, alternative construction possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0347:b001:l012: Beads/plumes/coral form an attributive fragment before the khan of Zungtung; inventory not split into additional verse rows.
notes.manas-2010:p0347:b001:l021: Speech assigned to Esenkan by subsequent self-identification. Opening quote editorial.
notes.manas-2010:p0347:b001:l044: Yudakhin бардигер/бардыгер: everything one has. Thus possessions here, not Almighty or a divine epithet. Dictionary also quotes the strength formula on p243.
notes.manas-2010:p0348:b001:l003: Accusative fragment Your khan who claims greatness retained; missing syntactic connection not invented or excluded as nonverse.
notes.manas-2010:p0348:b001:l010: Printed first-person condition retained across lines10–12; not silently changed to the recipient’s second person.
notes.manas-2010:p0348:b001:l014: Түмөн read as ten thousand; later army figure of one thousand retained separately.
notes.manas-2010:p0348:b001:l028: Себилдүү refers to being equipped/armored. Dictionary cites this exact eighty-four formula. Armament is a cautious reading; whether the number counts equipment or equipped men remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0348:b001:l045: Mountain comparison retained with rhetorical negation; not reduced to an abstract warning.
notes.manas-2010:p0349:b001:l012: Elliptical guise/mistaken-identity construction: Jakyp apparently hid his identity as though a Kalmyk; printed words retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0349:b001:l022: Printed жер (place) retained, not silently emended to шер (lion). Metaphoric source of fire is awkward but interpretable.
notes.manas-2010:p0349:b001:l027: Döngö is directly addressed here despite earlier reported death; source contradiction preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0349:b001:l040: Eighteen thousand worlds is cosmological language, not population or territory count.
notes.manas-2010:p0349:b001:l044: Printed second-person Your boy retained despite surrounding third-person narration.
notes.manas-2010:p0350:b001:l015: Binding on the severed heads understood from carriage command; reflexive morphology makes precise subject relation uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0350:b001:l019: Чамгарак: structural crown/crosspieces of a yurt roof; no modern house substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p0350:b001:l022: Караласа provisionally looks after/looks to livestock; subject remains implicit.
notes.manas-2010:p0350:b001:l025: Кээсин чыгаруу is explicitly defined as taking revenge in the 2015 phraseological and explanatory dictionaries, with the closely matching epic formula Капкайдагы кээсин. Rendered settle the score from long ago across lines24–25; earlier provisional fury reading rejected.
notes.manas-2010:p0350:b001:l030: Кычык сөз: provocation/defiant speech; exact force of алуу is uncertain. Paired with the sore-spot idiom next row.
notes.manas-2010:p0350:b001:l040: Baltay is the shortened Akbaltay form as printed; retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0350:b001:l047: Tagylyk retained as a name/group label; exact status unclear, not silently translated as an office.
notes.manas-2010:p0351:b001:l001: Stone ornaments read as rank insignia in the epic official’s dress; not stones carried as weapons.
notes.manas-2010:p0351:b001:l002: Тазалары: shaven/bald-headed men, not moral purity.
notes.manas-2010:p0351:b001:l025: Чоюнбаш provisionally iron-headed, describing armed troops. It can also denote an iron-headed mace; compound syntax needs specialist review.
notes.manas-2010:p0351:b001:l034: Orderly characterization retained alongside descriptions of the army’s confusion.
notes.manas-2010:p0351:b001:l035: Deluge-survival claim retained as narrator’s epic account, not history.
notes.manas-2010:p0351:b001:l038: Зубун: troop unit/division in Yudakhin and Manas encyclopedia; seven units retained without assigning modern unit size.
notes.manas-2010:p0352:b001:l003: Ноопас: young bull/steer. The meal differs from the whole-pig image on p347; both retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0352:b001:l027: Gray yurt coverings stand for the nomadic people who live under them; source material image preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0352:b001:l033: One thousand retained despite ten thousand promised at p348:l014; no arithmetic reconciliation.
notes.manas-2010:p0352:b001:l048: Printed seeing his fame/name is rendered idiomatically as name inspiring fear.
notes.manas-2010:p0353:b001:l003: Жайчы: weather-conjurer; zykyrchy denotes sorcery here, not ordinary meteorology.
notes.manas-2010:p0353:b001:l006: Андис read provisionally as variant of adept/expert; not asserted as a separate named character.
notes.manas-2010:p0353:b001:l022: One thousand for Karazhoy retained; separate from Zholoy’s force.
notes.manas-2010:p0353:b001:l025: Cultivator of wisdom retains the дыйкан agricultural metaphor for resourcefulness.
notes.manas-2010:p0353:b001:l032: Кымбат interpreted precious of the sword/edge; line’s exact attribution is compressed.
notes.manas-2010:p0353:b001:l036: Кыйбат жерде жайлалуу provisionally stationed in a perilous place; surrounding tethered champion image uncertain in detail.
notes.manas-2010:p0353:b001:l037: Кылып ийчү has an unstated action/object; strike is a tentative martial completion, not recovery of missing source words.
notes.manas-2010:p0353:b001:l038: Кынжы is collar/chain, not belt: Yudakhin and 2015 dictionary give dog collar and chain and cite tethered epic champions. Literal restraint image retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0353:b001:l041: One thousand for Döödür retained as a distinct commander’s force.

excluded_source_ids.reason: Visually checked centered chapter heading; translated separately.

headings.raw: Эсенкан буйрук менен Жолойду баш кылып, Манаска кол аткарганы
headings.en: Esenkan orders an army against Manas under Zholoy’s command

transcription_check.scope: All twenty page images rendered at 1600 pixels and visually inspected against Kyrgyz extraction. One chapter heading separated; all verse repetitions retained. Raw unchanged. This checks the digital PDF witness, not an original manuscript.

alignment_check.method: All 956 Kyrgyz/English pairs read in five consecutive four-page groups after drafting; explicit ordered IDs and per-page row counts checked. Dictionary corrections applied to governors, Kechil, splendid spear, armament and tether collar.

translation_provenance: Direct Kyrgyz-to-English draft from source extraction and all page images. No acquired prior English translation or translation service used. Selected dictionary checks only; provisional lexical/syntactic readings noted per ID. No independent specialist review.
